description: This file defines an interface 'BodySummarizerInterface' in the GuzzleHttp namespace. It declares a method 'summarize' that takes a MessageInterface and returns a nullable string, intended to provide a summarized version of a message body.

classes.name: BodySummarizerInterface
classes.description: An interface defining a contract for summarizing message bodies in the GuzzleHttp library.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Returns a summarized message body as a string or null, given a MessageInterface instance.
